patterns.note: A dark mode aesthetic is consistently applied across all pages, using a black background with high-contrast white text and vibrant accent colors.
Content is presented in full-width sections with generous vertical spacing, often featuring asymmetrical arrangements of text and high-quality video or image grids.
Headings utilize a large, bold, sans-serif typeface, often in all caps, for strong visual impact, contrasting with a clean, readable sans-serif for body text.
A limited but impactful color palette features a dominant black background, white primary text, and a striking red/pink accent for calls to action and interactive elements.

The main navigation bar transforms into a smaller, sticky header with a solid black background upon scroll, while the hero section features a parallax effect where the video grid scrolls at a different rate than the main text.
Interactive video thumbnail grids are used prominently in hero sections and content carousels to showcase the platform's offerings and instructors.

technique_notes: The site employs a persistent dark mode design, using a solid black background with white text for maximum contrast and a premium feel.
A sticky header is implemented, which shrinks in height and gains a solid background color as the user scrolls down the page.
The hero section utilizes a parallax scrolling effect, where the main textual content remains relatively fixed while a grid of video thumbnails scrolls at a slower rate, creating depth.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, often uppercase sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) create strong visual hierarchy, complemented by a clear, readable sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: subtle rounded corners on buttons, input fields, and image containers, maintaining a clean yet approachable aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with significant vertical padding between major sections, creating a sense of spaciousness, while content grids maintain a balanced density.

standout: The site's distinctive dark mode, combined with its immersive presentation of high-quality video content and expert instructors, creates a premium, editorial learning experience. The interactive hero video grid and subtle parallax effects elevate it beyond a standard marketing page, making the content itself the primary design element.
